capabilities: Open .pptx files in a dedicated read-only view
Extract slide text and speaker notes
List media references, relationships and package diagnostics
Filter slide text, notes and media metadata
Warn about macros, encryption, external relationships and malformed packages
disambiguation: Not a presentation or slideshow tool; it only displays extracted slide text and package details, read-only.
extras: Read-only by design: no editing, saving, annotation, export, network calls or external app launch. Only .pptx (OOXML) is supported; legacy .ppt binaries are not.
problem: Obsidian cannot open PowerPoint files, so there is no way to inspect a deck's slide text or speaker notes without leaving the app or converting the file.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .pptx decks in Obsidian to show slide text, speaker notes, media references and package diagnostics.
